preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is a positive integer between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n <= 2000 for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is the length of the string, a is the substring length, and both are positive integers with 1 ≤ a ≤ n ≤ 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= min(26, a) for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, b is the required number of distinct letters in each substring of length a, with 1 ≤ b ≤ min(26, a).

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, a, b in test_cases) <= 2000
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output string s has length exactly equal to the input n.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
postconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(s[i:i+a])) == b for i in range(n - a + 1))
postconditions.description: Every substring of length a in s has exactly b distinct letters.
